definitions.explanation: The state of being unable to see. In modern usage, {盲目|もうもく} as a literal medical term is increasingly avoided in favor of more respectful expressions.
Being unable or unwilling to see the truth; accepting something without critical thought. The figurative sense is the most common use today.

examples.japanese: {盲目|もうもく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ピアニスト→ピアニスト：19413_pianisuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}した→演奏する：20349_ensousuru⟧。
⟦{生|う}まれつき→生まれつき：21201_umaretsuki⟧{盲目|もうもく}だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恵|めぐ}まれた→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧。
examples.english: Born blind, but blessed with musical talent.

examples.japanese: {盲目|もうもく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支援|しえん}する→支援する：25534_shiensuru⟧⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄付|きふ}した→寄付する：20661_kifusuru⟧。
examples.english: I donated to an organization that supports blind people.

examples.japanese: {盲目|もうもく}{的|てき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{信|しん}じて→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
{盲目|もうもく}{的|てき}な⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。

⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{盲目|もうもく}{的|てき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れ→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧ず、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important not to accept information blindly but to think for yourself.

notes:
USAGE:
The literal sense (sense 1) is used in literary, historical, and some formal contexts, but in everyday Japanese it is increasingly considered insensitive. More respectful alternatives include ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不自由|ふじゆう}→不自由：03596_fujiyuu⟧な⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ or ⟦{視覚|しかく}{障害者|しょうがいしゃ}→視覚障害者：30412_shikakushougaisha⟧.

The figurative sense (sense 2) is more freely used and is the primary modern usage. {盲目|もうもく}{的|てき} (blindly, uncritically) is the most common form in this sense.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盲目|もうもく}{的|てき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: blindly, uncritically
- {盲目|もうもく}{的|てき}な⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧: blind love
- {盲目|もうもく}{的|てき}な⟦{崇拝|すうはい}→崇拝：10032_suuhai⟧: blind worship
- {盲目|もうもく}{的|てき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to follow blindly
